ex.en: Moles live underground and can barely see.
ex.zh: 鼴鼠住在地底下，幾乎看不見東西。

ex.en: The company suspected a mole was leaking its secrets.
ex.zh: 公司懷疑有內奸在洩漏機密。

ex.en: The police finally found the mole in their department.
ex.zh: 警方終於揪出了部門裡的內奸。

ex.en: She is studying molecular biology at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學念分子生物學。

ex.en: Scientists examined the molecular structure of the new drug.
ex.zh: 科學家研究了這種新藥的分子結構。

ex.en: He was scared when the monkey jumped at him.
ex.zh: 猴子朝他撲過來時，他嚇了一跳。

ex.en: It is easy for a monkey to climb a tree.
ex.zh: 爬樹對猴子來說很容易。

ex.en: Monkeys can learn a lot of tricks.
ex.zh: 猴子能學會很多把戲。

ex.en: Stop monkeying around and finish your homework.
ex.zh: 別再胡鬧了，快把功課寫完。

ex.en: The kids were monkeying around in the classroom.
ex.zh: 孩子們在教室裡胡鬧。

ex.en: Many people question the morality of the decision.
ex.zh: 很多人質疑這個決定是否合乎道德。

ex.en: The novel explores themes of love and morality.
ex.zh: 這部小說探討愛與道德的主題。

ex.en: The researchers compared the morphological features of the two species.
ex.zh: 研究人員比較了這兩個物種的形態特徵。

ex.en: Morphological analysis studies how words are formed.
ex.zh: 詞法分析研究單字是如何構成的。

ex.en: The plant's morphology changes in dry climates.
ex.zh: 這種植物的形態在乾燥氣候中會改變。

ex.en: She wrote her thesis on the morphology of insects.
ex.zh: 她的論文主題是昆蟲的形態學。

ex.en: Morphology is the study of how words are built.
ex.zh: 構詞學是研究單字如何構成的學問。

ex.en: Chinese morphology is quite different from English.
ex.zh: 中文的構詞方式和英文很不一樣。

ex.en: Infant mortality has fallen sharply in recent decades.
ex.zh: 近幾十年來，嬰兒死亡率大幅下降。

ex.en: The disease has a high mortality rate.
ex.zh: 這種疾病的死亡率很高。

ex.en: The accident made him think about his own mortality.
ex.zh: 這場意外讓他思考起自己終將一死。

ex.en: Getting older reminds us of our mortality.
ex.zh: 年紀漸長讓我們意識到生命有限。

ex.en: The dress has a flower motif.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝有花朵圖案。

ex.en: The wallpaper features a simple leaf motif.
ex.zh: 這款壁紙以簡單的葉子圖案為特色。

motif.zh: （作品中反覆出現的）主題、主旨

ex.en: Travel is a recurring motif in her novels.
ex.zh: 旅行是她小說中反覆出現的主題。

ex.en: Water is a key motif in the film.
ex.zh: 水是這部電影的重要意象。

ex.en: This is the worst movie I have ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我看過的最差勁的電影了。

ex.en: My father took me to a movie last night.
ex.zh: 我爸爸昨晚帶我去看電影。

ex.en: She used to go to the movies on Sundays.
ex.zh: 她以前星期天都會去看電影。

ex.en: At last, they reached the top of the mountain.
ex.zh: 他們終於到達了山頂。

ex.en: The mountain is not as high as Mt. Fuji.
ex.zh: 這座山沒有富士山高。

ex.en: My younger brother really likes to take photos of mountains.
ex.zh: 我弟弟很喜歡拍山的照片。

ex.en: I have a mountain of work to do today.
ex.zh: 我今天有一大堆工作要做。

ex.en: There's a mountain of laundry on the bed.
ex.zh: 床上堆了一大堆要洗的衣服。

ex.en: When you're done sweeping, I'll mop.
ex.zh: 你掃完地之後，我來拖地。

ex.en: Tom mopped the floor.
ex.zh: 湯姆拖了地。

ex.en: The mop is in the closet next to the bathroom.
ex.zh: 拖把在浴室旁邊的櫃子裡。

ex.en: Wring out the mop before you use it.
ex.zh: 用之前先把拖把擰乾。

ex.en: He mocks me.
ex.zh: 他嘲笑我。

ex.en: Some students mocked him for his accent.
ex.zh: 有些學生嘲笑他的口音。

ex.en: The future pilot is trained in a mock cockpit.
ex.zh: 未來飛行員將在模擬操作室中訓練。

ex.en: Students took a mock exam before the real test.
ex.zh: 學生們在正式考試前先參加了模擬考。

ex.en: Winds from the sea are moist.
ex.zh: 從海洋吹來的風感覺溼漉漉的。

ex.en: Keep the soil moist but not wet.
ex.zh: 讓土壤保持濕潤但不要積水。

ex.en: The cake was soft and moist.
ex.zh: 這個蛋糕又軟又濕潤。

ex.en: The injured man moaned in pain.
ex.zh: 受傷的男子痛苦地呻吟。

ex.en: Stop moaning about the weather and enjoy the trip.
ex.zh: 別再抱怨天氣，好好享受旅程吧。

ex.en: We heard a low moan from the next room.
ex.zh: 我們聽見隔壁房間傳來低低的呻吟聲。

ex.en: The wind made a long moan through the trees.
ex.zh: 風在樹林間發出長長的嗚咽聲。

ex.en: In the story, a monstrous creature lived under the bridge.
ex.zh: 故事裡，橋底下住著一隻怪物般的可怕生物。

ex.en: The dictator was responsible for monstrous crimes.
ex.zh: 那名獨裁者犯下了駭人聽聞的罪行。

ex.en: She broke the monotony of office work by taking up painting.
ex.zh: 她靠學畫畫來打破辦公室工作的單調。

ex.en: The monotony of the long drive made him sleepy.
ex.zh: 長途駕駛的單調讓他昏昏欲睡。

ex.en: The widow mourned her husband for a long time.
ex.zh: 寡婦為她的丈夫哀悼了很久。

ex.en: The widow mourned for her husband for a long time.
ex.zh: 寡婦為她的丈夫哀悼了很久。

ex.en: The whole country mourned the death of the famous singer.
ex.zh: 全國都在哀悼那位知名歌手的逝世。

ex.en: He was opposed to monopolies.
ex.zh: 他反對壟斷。

ex.en: The company has a monopoly on the city's water supply.
ex.zh: 這家公司壟斷了全市的供水。

ex.en: Monopoly is a popular game for families to play.
ex.zh: 大富翁是很受家庭歡迎的遊戲。

ex.en: We played Monopoly all night.
ex.zh: 我們玩了一整晚的大富翁。

ex.en: We took out a 30-year mortgage to buy our home.
ex.zh: 我們申請了三十年的房貸買房子。

ex.en: Most of my salary goes to the mortgage.
ex.zh: 我大部分的薪水都拿去付房貸。

ex.en: He compared his car to the new model.
ex.zh: 他拿自己的車和新款比較。

ex.en: This is the latest model of the phone.
ex.zh: 這是這支手機的最新型號。

ex.en: Mike has been making a model plane since breakfast.
ex.zh: 邁克從早餐後就一直在做模型飛機。

ex.en: All models are wrong, but some are useful.
ex.zh: 所有的模型都是錯的，但有些是有用的。

ex.en: She is said to have been a model.
ex.zh: 據說她以前當過模特兒。

ex.en: The model walked down the runway.
ex.zh: 模特兒走上伸展台。

ex.en: The moderator invited questions from the audience.
ex.zh: 主持人邀請觀眾提問。

ex.en: Our moderator kept the panel discussion on schedule.
ex.zh: 我們的主持人讓座談會按時進行。

modular.zh: 模組化的；由標準組件構成的

ex.en: The modular system is easy to expand.
ex.zh: 這套模組化系統很容易擴充。

ex.en: We chose modular furniture for the new office.
ex.zh: 我們為新辦公室選用了模組化家具。

ex.en: Motorists should avoid the tunnel while crews repair the lights.
ex.zh: 施工人員維修照明期間，駕駛人應避開該隧道。

ex.en: The sign warns motorists that the road narrows ahead.
ex.zh: 這個標誌提醒駕駛人前方道路會縮窄。

ex.en: A monument was built to honor the soldiers.
ex.zh: 人們建了一座紀念碑來紀念那些士兵。

ex.en: The old temple is a national monument.
ex.zh: 那座古廟是國定古蹟。
